Quality of food is so good that you can make out the difference. featured_reviews.name: Prakash Dhalwani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ambience & Parking: ⭐⭐⭐
Decent vibe, though the seating was a bit uncomfortable. We pre-booked our table via Zomato. Valet is available, but note that they park your car on the street. A quick shoutout to the bathrooms—very clean and hygienic!

Service: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Excellent. The staff was incredibly quick, efficient, and responsive throughout the meal.

Food & Drinks:
✅ Truffle Salmon Sushi - Absolute perfection with amazing flavor. (5/5)
✅ Egg Fried Rice - Flawless, classic taste, and good portion size. (5/5)
✅ Avocado Cream Cheese Sushi - A great, creamy option. (4/5)
✅ Chicken and Chilli Oil Dumplings - Nice flavor with a good spicy kick. (4/5)
❌ Chicken Spring Roll - Pretty average, nothing memorable. (3/5)
❌ Lemon Ice Tea & Jade Mojito - Both felt a bit uninspiring for the price. (3/5)
⭐Truffle Salmon Sushi - Easily the standout dish of the entire meal!

Pricing & Value:
Our bill was around ₹4,500 for 3 people. Given the good portion sizes and quality of the mains, it felt fair.

💡Pro Tip:
Pre-book on Zomato! They have a 25% discount running, but slots are limited.

Overall:
A solid spot with remarkably fast service and excellent sushi, though it's held back slightly by average drinks and stiff seating.

Would I Recommend It?
Depends (Definitely go if you can grab the Zomato discount and stick to their top-tier sushi).

Must Try:
Truffle Salmon Sushi, Egg Fried Rice

Skip:
Chicken Spring Roll, Jade Mojito

featured_reviews.name: chanakya dhiman
featured_reviews.review_text:
An Unforgettable Asian Dining Experience in the Heart of Khar!
If you're looking for a restaurant that delivers on every front — breathtaking interiors, extraordinary food, and an experience that lingers long after the meal — look no further than PF Chang's, Khar. This place is an absolute gem, and my recent visit left me completely blown away.

The moment you step inside PF Chang's, you're transported into a world of stunning elegance. The interiors are nothing short of spectacular — a seamless blend of contemporary design and rich Asian-inspired aesthetics. From the dramatic lighting and intricate décor to the beautifully curated artwork and warm, inviting tones, every corner of this restaurant is Instagram-worthy. The space feels luxurious yet comfortable, making it perfect for a romantic date night, a family celebration, or a fun outing with friends. It's the kind of place where the ambiance alone is worth the visit.

Now, let's talk about the food — because PF Chang's truly takes Asian cuisine to another level. The menu is a love letter to the flavors of Asia, and every dish we tried was an absolute revelation. The dishes were bursting with bold, authentic flavors, perfectly balanced with the right amount of spice, sweetness, and umami. The portions were generous, the ingredients were fresh, and the presentation was exquisite. From the starters to the mains, each plate was crafted with care and culinary finesse. This is Asian food at its absolute finest!

The staff were warm, professional, and genuinely passionate about making your dining experience special. The team was attentive without being intrusive, and their knowledge of the menu made ordering an enjoyable experience in itself.
Overall, PF Chang's in Khar, Mumbai is a world-class dining destination that truly lives up to its global reputation. It's not just a meal — it's an experience. If you haven't visited yet, you're seriously missing out. This is one restaurant I will be returning to again and again without hesitation.
Highly recommended — a perfect 10/10! 🥢✨

featured_reviews.name: Ninad joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Whenever I intended to travel to Mumbai, we always make an effort to discover new dining; this time, we chose to visit P.F. Chang's in Khar.

On Saturday evening, our cousins planned to go to this venue, so we made a reservation through Zomato.

After we settled in, one of my cousins started placing the order. We enjoyed the following dishes:
- Orange Chicken
- Original Dynamite Shrimp
- Avocado Cream Cheese Roll
- Aburi Salmon Roll
- Handmade Chicken Dumplings
- Pan-Fried Crab Wonton
- Wok Charred Chicken
- Hand-Folded Crab Wontons
- Signature Lo Mein
- Singapore Street Noodles
- Sticky Toffee Pudding
- Chicken in Black Bean Sauce
- Hot Garlic Sichuan Chicken

**Must Try**
1. Orange Chicken; this dish was exceptionally delicious, and the flavor of the orange was outstanding.
2. The Original Dynamite Shrimp was delightful in taste, featuring a blend of creamy, spicy mayonnaise, sriracha, and sweet chili sauce.
3. The Handmade Chicken Dumplings were also quite tasty.

**Recommendation**
Both sushi rolls were delicious, and I would recommend them:
1. Avocado Cream Cheese Roll
2. Aburi Salmon Roll

The service was prompt, and the highlight was that every dish arrived on time. The soothing background music contributed to a relaxing atmosphere.

Overall, it was a wonderful experience for us, and I would certainly recommend this place.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently revisited this upscale Chinese restaurant for brunch, despite previous underwhelming experiences. Unfortunately, the lack of natural light and overuse of tacky blue lights remained a major turnoff. The ambiance, while appealing to some, doesn’t  resonate with me.
The food, while reasonably priced during brunch, didn't change my opinion about Chinese cuisine in Bombay. It still feels like a generic Chinese restaurant in a five-star hotel.

On a positive note, the staff was attentive and well-trained, with noticeably more staff members on deck. The addition of a smoking cabin upstairs was convenient, and the toned-down music was a welcome change. The unlimited flow of good brand cocktails was a great value.

While this restaurant still isn't my favorite, I appreciate the positive changes in price, smoking area, and music volume.

featured_reviews.name: Suyash Karangutkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re a fan of bold flavors and comforting desi Chinese, Fat Kong is the kind of place that satisfies every craving with just the right hit of spice, crunch, and umami.

Crispy Chicken:
This dish was a knockout. The chicken pieces were perfectly battered—thin, golden, and fried to a shatteringly crisp texture. The outside had that addictive crunch, while the inside stayed juicy and tender. Tossed in a sticky, mildly spicy glaze with hints of garlic, soy, and chili, it was garnished with spring onions and sesame seeds, making it hard to stop at just one piece.

Chicken Triple Rice & Schezwan Noodles:
The Chicken Triple Rice was a full-on flavor bomb—a mix of fried rice and schezwan gravy poured generously on top, loaded with chopped veggies, chicken chunks, and a fried egg to top it all off. It was hearty, spicy, and soul-satisfying in that uniquely desi-Chinese way.

The Schezwan Noodles had a perfect wok-char (you know that smoky “wok hei” touch), with the right chewiness and a punchy garlic-chili flavor that didn’t overpower. Again, the chicken pieces were soft and well-seasoned, blending nicely with the heat of the schezwan sauce and the crunch of stir-fried vegetables.

featured_reviews.name: Ashutosh Bohra
featured_reviews.review_text:
It's with a heavy heart that I have to give 2 stars to a restaurant which was one of my favourites earlier on. Before the restaurant was located on SV Road Opposite Dynasty restaurant and everything was top class. It was one of those restaurants where we visited every weekend and it was always full so we had to wait 15 to 20 mins to get a table, and it was worth the wait.

So after around a decade I decided to revisit this restaurant for nostalgia and to try their iconic starters which made me drool earlier on.

So they are having two outlets now Jogeshwari and Khar, I visited the Khar outlet and was happy to see the restaurant maintaining their yellow and red colour theme. I was the only one present in their restaurant and was greeted by Akshay the person managing this outlet.

After requesting that I wish to try 2 dishes he was kind enough to give me 1/2 portion of my favourite Chicken Lollipop Hakka Style and Full portion of Crispy Spinach Chicken.

As soon as the lollipops were served the aroma transported me to the old era it was so beautiful and they have done well to maintain their taste as it was before.

But now comes the sad part, I got a piece of plastic spoon in my mouth while having the dish and was angry, disappointed and sad. I was advised by some of my friends that I should avoid the restaurant as it's not maintained the same way like before, but still I decided to try and I was like this is the end of Fatkongs for me.

I requested the Manager to not charge me for this dish and speak to the owner regarding this but he was helpless and they decided not to take away the charges.

Even though this incident took place I still ate the second dish Crispy Spinach Chicken, but it was nowhere close to the one which I used to eat before. The spinach didn't seem fresh and the chicken had a thick coating and wasn't good. So with a heavy heart I left the restaurant putting down a message to the owner who did give me a call and tried to give explanation and reasoning, though admitting that it wasn't right. But somehow I didn't feel like trying this restaurant again.

featured_reviews.name: Pratik K. Mody
featured_reviews.review_text:
Nom Nom is such a vibe!

The ambience really stands out! That warm, dim lighting sets the perfect mood for an intimate dinner without feeling too “try-hard.” It’s the kind of place where you naturally slow down, settle in, and actually enjoy the evening.
The food, overall, was really good and definitely amps up the experience. That said, I’d love to see a wider variety of sushi and noodle dishes on the menu. The bao bun was a bit on the chewy side, and the filling-to-bun ratio felt slightly off (could’ve used more filling). The silken tofu, though was an absolute standout. It genuinely melted in the mouth and was a wow dish, even if I wish the portion was a little more generous. The peach iced tea was perfect. Dessert-wise, the mango sticky rice could’ve been better, it felt a bit like mango purée with pieces and rice, missing that coconut-y flavour and crunch (both of which are not very difficult to crack).
Definitely a spot I’d come back to (and happily recommend) when I’m in the mood for a relaxed, date-night style dinner.

Dynasty: The Indo-Chinese Restaurant That Doesn’t Need Buzz
Five stars aren’t enough, but they’ll have to do.
Dynasty operates in that rare territory where quality speaks louder than Instagram followers. This unpretentious neighborhood spot has mastered the art of authentic Indo-Chinese cooking — the kind that requires skill, not shortcuts.
Order the Chicken Lollipop and you’ll understand immediately. Each piece is a study in balance: crisp exterior, succulent interior, perfectly seasoned. The Manchow Soup arrives with the kind of umami depth that makes you wonder why other restaurants even bother. The Crispy Spinach Chicken demands respect, while the Crispy Thread Chicken delivers texture with purpose. These aren’t interpretations — they’re the genuine article.
But the real revelation lies in the Sour Chili and Sichuan dips. Layered, bold, and unapologetically complex, they’re the kind of accompaniments that transform a meal into an experience. The lemon iced tea cuts through it all with perfect timing.
What distinguishes Dynasty, though, is the service. The team moves with purpose, never intrusive, always present. It’s a family restaurant in the truest sense — one that makes you feel like you belong.
In a city saturated with forgettable Indo-Chinese, Dynasty reminds you why authenticity never goes out of style.

Dynasty Restaurant, Khar West: A Chinese Culinary Journey

Dynasty Restaurant in Khar West, Mumbai, is a haven for Chinese food enthusiasts. This popular eatery has been delighting taste buds with its authentic and flavorful dishes for years. Whether you're craving spicy, tangy, or sweet, Dynasty has something to offer.

One of the must-try dishes at Dynasty is their Crispy Spinach Paneer. This vegetarian delight features tender cubes of paneer coated in a crispy batter and tossed with fresh spinach. The combination of textures and flavors is simply irresistible. For a refreshing drink to complement your meal, try their Ice Lemon Tea. The tartness of the lemon combined with the sweetness of the tea makes it a perfect thirst quencher.

If you're looking for something spicy, the Paneer Chilli is a great option. Tender pieces of paneer are stir-fried with a spicy chili sauce, making it a fiery dish that will leave your taste buds tingling. For a unique twist on Chinese cuisine, try the Schezwan Crispy Veg. This dish features mixed vegetables coated in a crispy batter and tossed in a spicy Schezwan sauce.

For a satisfying main course, consider the Veg Burnt Garlic Rice or the Veg Malaysian Noodles. Both dishes are packed with flavor and are sure to leave you feeling full and satisfied. Dynasty also offers a variety of Indian Chinese dishes, combining traditional Indian flavors with Chinese cooking techniques.

To start your meal, the Manchow Soup is a classic choice. This flavorful soup is packed with vegetables and a hint of spice. For a refreshing and tangy drink, try the Sweet and Salty Lime Soda. The combination of sweet and salty flavors is a unique and refreshing treat.

Whether you're a seasoned Chinese food lover or new to the cuisine, Dynasty Restaurant in Khar West is a must-visit. With its delicious food, friendly service, and inviting atmosphere, it's no wonder why this restaurant is so popular among locals and tourists alike.
